cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the central atrium of a space station — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a quiet indoor panoramic lift rising through a bright botanical atrium — enjoying the view during a slow ride; her quiet room beside a large home aquarium of green water plants — dangles a pair of strappy high-heeled shoes from two fingers by their straps; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; an empty sunroom with an indoor fabric hammock — enjoying a slow late-morning hammock break; an amusement-park parade street lined with spectators — perched on a ledge or edge; the bridge of a warship of her world — brings a cup to her lips; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; a sunny seaside boardwalk lined with palms — gliding forward on her skates; the open palm of a towering giant mecha kneeling in its hangar — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her left side; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a slim tube of deep-red lipstick; the splash pool at the foot of tall twisting water slides — standing
